purpose: Reuse verified role responses to choose target members for unseen sparse interventions
budget: Four target confirmations: at most1200driver seconds each and100MB combined. Pilot348.18sec included832gradient batches and1728evaluation forwards; confirmations reuse source/raw banks, compute256target-comparator gradients and3456eval forwards each. Expected~6min per target, hard80min combined maximum.
statistics_unit: 32 new world clusters shared by four fixed target SAE dictionaries, one fixed source. Report targets separately; average across targets within world, never treat directions as independent seeds.
primary_endpoint: At16members, both city answers correct for entity exchange AND entity-plus-attribute restoration in same context; source-path selection versus geometry, pooled-source, raw-path and direct-target-path controls. Predict margin gain separately from behavioral utility.
scope: Frozen R57 selection rules and source/raw response banks. Four target retrainings, fresh worlds after64 exposed development/confirmation worlds; fit expression forms and two forms absent from response fitting. No response/selection adaptation to confirmation outputs.
